newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo bourse falls on disppointing Hydro results.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse falls on disppointing Hydro results.

text.p: Norway's largest listed company Norsk Hydro ASA disappointed investors with 1996 annual profits on Monday and single handedly wiped more than two percent off the Oslo bourse's Total share index.
The industrial giant said lower earnings from metals and petrochemicals had led to a 10 percent decline in 1996 operating profit to 9.65 billion crowns.
The result fell more than one billion crowns below market expectations. Market reaction was swift, Hydro's share tumbling 10.5 crowns on the open to 368 crowns.
